text.text: It is with very sincere regret that I share my experience with the bank that I speak about my recent stint within the so-called prestigious CIH bank. Indeed, my experience was dampened by immeasurable expectations, accentuated by the unannounced absence of certain members of staff. What should have been a simple banking formality unfortunately turned into hours or even an entire day wasted. Is there a specific purpose behind this time spent on customers without the slightest consideration? Why are these followers left in a desolate state of uncertainty waiting patiently without knowing whether their requests would be answered or not? As a result, this disorganization directly impacts the one-off commitments of those loyal to the bank, often leading to breaches of personal and professional obligations. Obviously, the attitude of the hierarchy called into question in its entirety, from the highest paid executive to the employee whose income seems insufficient to provide for the necessities of life, in short, the internal atmosphere diffuses in the air a sort of arrogance at all levels which only intensifies the inconvenience of customers, and reveals a striking gap between the reality experienced daily by these faithful and the overall strategy of the bank. So it’s normal to ask the question, why not organize yourself better? leave ambiguity lingering? Keeping up a mystery? .. what is certain is that today, the CIH bank would have no choice but to seriously re-examine its internal organization, with an emphasis on punctuality, transparency regarding the availability of agents , and improving working conditions for all of its staff. In the hope that this constructive criticism encourages the CIH bank to reevaluate its practices, I cannot repress a deep sadness at the inconvenience suffered by us (former clients), who had chosen to entrust our trust to this revered institution.

originalText.text: C'est avec un regret très sincère que je partage mon expérience avec la banque que je m'exprime au sujet de mon récent passage au sein de la dite prestigieuse banque CIH. En effet, mon expérience a été ensommeillée par des attentes incommensurables, accentuées par l'absence non-annoncée de certains membres du personnel. Ce qui aurait dû être une simple formalité bancaire s'est transformé malheureusement en heures voir une journée entière de perdue. Y a t-il un but précis derrière ce temps foulé des clients sans la moindre considération ? Pourquoi ces adeptes sont laissés un état d'incertitude désolant attendant patiemment sans savoir si leurs requêtes seraient traitées ou non ? Résultat, cette désorganisation impacte directement les engagements ponctuels des fidèles à la banque, occasionnant souvent un manquements aux obligations personnelles et professionnelles. Visiblement, l'attitude de la hiérarchie remise en question dans sa globalité, du cadre le mieux payé au salarié dont les revenus semblent insuffisants pour subvenir aux nécessités de la vie, bref, l'ambiance interne diffuse dans l'air une sorte d'arrogance à tous les étages qui ne fait qu'intensifier le désagrément des clients, et révèle un hiatus frappant entre la réalité vécue quotidiennement par ces fidèles et la stratégie globale de la banque. Alors c'est normal de se poser la question, pourquoi ne pas mieux s'organiser ? laisser trainer l'ambiguïté ? Entretenir un mystère ? .. ce qui est sur, c'est qu'aujourd'hui, la banque CIH n'aurait plus aucun choix que de réexaminer sérieusement son organisation interne, en mettant l'accent sur la ponctualité, la transparence quant à la disponibilité des agents, et l'amélioration des conditions de travail pour l'ensemble de son personnel. Dans l'espoir que cette critique constructive incite la banque CIH à réévaluer ses pratiques, je ne peux réprimer une profonde tristesse face aux désagréments subis par nous (ex clients), qui avions choisi de confier notre confiance à cette institution vénérée.

Consider a regrettable experience!
I have consulted in 2017 for an immobile credit card, but I am waiting for the façon comment ils accueillent la clientèle! And the impression says there are limited limited outputs...
Autumn, and now I regret it, I saw my experience, but it was better!
I came to them just to know how they could come with me to finance the purchase and construction of a spot. I was asking what was the possible financing ceiling based on my monthly income, and Mr. Agent, would you please tell me what is the price of the spot? Where do you want to buy?
Oh Sharif, I still haven't seen a spot. I wanted to know how you can finance me... Ella is in a state like she's running out with something they brought from the theater and they put it on as a scarf and put it in a desk! The client apologized that he did not know, we went to the fancy man with a beard, he had a costume and a scarf....
I left them with the same feeling and frustration that I left with in 2017. Along with them, I entered a usurious bank, and just like that, I went from darkness to light. He gave me sufficient and comprehensive information and sent me a visit card so we can answer any inquiries from afar!
The question is: Is Umniah Bank really a bank, or just a fancy façade for an activity, and they don’t care about customers or commercial activity?

Je les ai consultés en 2017 pour un crédit immobilier, mais j'étais déçu de la façon comment ils accueillent la clientèle ! Et l'impression qu'ils donnent avec leurs explications trop limité...
Aujourd'hui, et avec regret, j'ai vécu la même expérience, mais plus pire!
جيت لعندهم نعرف فقط شحال يقدو يوصلو معايا فتمويل شراء و بناء بقعة، أنا كانسول شحال سقف التمويل الممكن انطلاقا من المدخول الشهري، و السيد العميل تايݣولي شحال ثمن البقعة ؟ فين باغي تشري؟

Bad experience!! I was with them to decide which bank I should use to buy an apartment and have a realistic commercial offer, but I was surprised by the lady who did the simulation for me on site, she simply put me as an SME employee, so the rate was very high. I asked her why did she put this status? Quite simply replied: "I didn't know your company, but to have a minimum rate you have to work for a large private group like Maroc telecom..!!! " I asked her this is the basis on which you judge if a company is large or just SME, she replied "it is the basis of the turnover!" So she does not even dare to have the minimum of information on my company which is a multinational which "Bank Almaghrib" and the "Moroccan government" trust in the field of identity security and which has a turnover exceeding that of Maroc Telecom which seems to her to be a large company....
Two weeks before I made the decision to engage with Umnia Bank and in 15 minutes everything was changed, of course I took a step back and moved towards Dar Alamane in the same day who offered me a more competitive and realistic commercial offer.
In short: customer relations are an art before being a profession

text.text:
A Moroccan acquaintance works in the wire transfer department at this branch of the Bank of Africa (BMCE Group), conveniently located on the Grand Socco (Place du 9 Avril 1947) in Tangier, Morocco.

I asked him about opening an account at the bank and a few weeks later I opened an account, with funds wired into the account and converted from U.S. dollars to Moroccan Dirhams. Within 10 days I returned to pick up my ATM and debit card that functions as a Visa, and to choose a pin code.

This Bank of Africa (Group BMCE) branch has an ATM machine outside, and you may also change money here.

The customer service man who had opened my account spoke good English and was very helpful and efficient, but by May 2022 he was not working for the bank and the woman who replaced him speaks only Spanish, French and Arabic.

شكرا على مستوى الخدمة المتميز الذي تقدمه المؤسسة. خلال تعاملي معكم، لم أستطع إلا أن أُعجب بالسرعة والاحترافية التي تُدار بها جميع الخدمات والمعاملات.

من اللحظة التي دخلت فيها إلى البنك، شعرت بترحيب استثنائي وبروح فريق العمل التي تعكس التفاني في تقديم أفضل تجربة للعملاء. الموظفون يتمتعون بمستوى عالٍ من الاحترافية، حيث يتعاملون بابتسامة دائمة وصبر كبير، ويوضحون التفاصيل بدقة مما يعزز ثقتي في التعامل مع البنك.

أما فيما يخص سرعة الخدمة، فهي بلا شك من أبرز ما يميزكم. كانت معاملاتي تُنجز بسهولة وسرعة دون أي تأخير يُذكر، وهذا يعكس التنظيم الممتاز والكفاءة العالية لفريق العمل.

أنتم نموذج يُحتذى به في القطاع المصرفي، ويستحق كل فرد من فريقكم الإشادة على الجهود المبذولة لجعل تجربة العملاء سلسة وممتعة.

أشكركم جزيل الشكر على هذه التجربة المميزة، وأتطلع إلى استمرار تعاملي معكم، متمنياً لكم دوام النجاح والتقدم.

Rating: ★★☆☆☆

I would like to share my experience with the bank located, Bd Pasteur, Tangier, Morocco. Although the location and appearance of the bank were attractive, the service I received was well below the expected standard.

I seriously intended to deposit a large sum of €17,500, but the staff of this agency left me more than disappointed. Despite the obvious importance of the transaction, I was offered poor service and a wait of up to two hours. For a bank that should take business transactions and customer service seriously, I found this completely inappropriate.

Additionally, the staff seemed to me not only disinterested and awkward, but also rude and arrogant. Their reluctance to perform their tasks efficiently, or to ensure appropriate waiting time, has been extremely disappointing.

It is essential that banks respect the needs of their customers and provide their services accordingly. In this specific case, I did not feel respected or treated well.

For these reasons, I can only rate this bank with two stars. I hope they will improve their service quality and treat their customers better in the future

Review of Attijariwafa Bank

I recently visited Attijariwafa Bank Ihlan Street, which opens at 8:30 a.m., half an hour later than most other banks. I arrived at 8:40 a.m., expecting them to be ready for customers. To my surprise, the staff was still preparing their clothes. When I asked the guard if I could go to the cashier, he told me that I should come back in an hour because they had “something to do.”

This experience was very frustrating and unprofessional. It is unacceptable for a bank to not be ready for customers even after its stated opening time. I wasted my time and had to rearrange my schedule due to their lack of organization. This kind of service seems like a joke and makes me doubt their reliability and competence.

I hope the bank addresses these issues quickly to avoid inconveniencing more customers in the future.

مراجعة لبنك التجاري وفابنك

قمت بزيارة بنك التجاري وفا بنك شارع اهلان مؤخرًا، والذي يفتح أبوابه في الساعة 8:30 صباحًا، أي نصف ساعة بعد معظم البنوك الأخرى. وصلت في الساعة 8:40 صباحًا، متوقعًا أن يكونوا جاهزين لاستقبال العملاء. ولدهشتي، كان الموظفون لا يزالون في طور التحضير ملابسهم. عندما سألت الحارس عن إمكانية الذهاب إلى الصراف، أخبرني أنه يجب عليّ العودة بعد ساعة لأن لديهم “شيء يجب القيام به.”

كانت هذه التجربة محبطة للغاية وغير مهنية. من غير المقبول أن يكون البنك غير جاهز للعملاء حتى بعد وقت فتحه المعلن. لقد أهدرت وقتي واضطررت إلى إعادة ترتيب جدول أعمالي بسبب نقص التنظيم لديهم. هذا النوع من الخدمة يبدو وكأنه مزحة ويجعلني أشك في موثوقيتهم وكفاءتهم.

آمل أن يقوم بنك بمعالجة هذه القضايا بسرعة لتجنب إزعاج المزيد من العملاء في المستقبل.

text.text:
Banque Populaire on Avenue Belgique has two ATM machines located in a safe area next to the front entrance.

This bank is one of the largest banks in Morocco and has currency exchange services. It is just down the road from Cafe La Tulipe and Emsallah.

I reduced my original rating of four stars to two in September 2018 after using the ATM machine and being shocked at the poor exchange rate given compared to BMCI and Société Générale. The rate was only 8.97 for one U.S. Dollar while the other banks' rates were 9.17, on the same day.

This is definitely not acceptable. I wonder why this big difference compared to other Moroccan banks in the exchange rates given at ATM machines.

Thus, I have decided never again to withdraw any money at any Banque Populaire location. The banks need to be regulated. It seems almost like thievery.

I would avoid withdrawing money from your foreign bank at any Banque Populaire. Go to any other major bank and get more money from your ATM transaction.

text.text:
Initially, I used the ATM machine at BMCI Place du Koweit whenever the Société Générale’s ATM around the corner was not working, which occured perhaps once a month.

But I now only use this BMCI Bank’s convenient branch location at “Iberia” rather the Société Générale’s ATM since that bank suddenly implemented an outrageous 18 Dirham per withdrawal fee.

An advantage of the BMCI's Place du Koweit ATM cash machine is that it always prints out paper receipts after your cash withdrawals.

When it is sunny outside, however, it can be somewhat difficult to read anything on the screen, so I tend not to use the machine at times of the day when it is hard to read the screen.

This BMCI Bank is an excellent major bank, with an excellent location. The ATM machine is located outside to the right of the bank's main entrance.

There is always a uniformed security guard standing inside the door who watches over you while using the ATM, so you feel safe while withdrawing cash in Moroccan Dirhams.

text.text:
This new bank opened in March 2018. CFG Bank is located directly next door to another large bank, BMCI, at the Place du Koweit ("Iberia"), and also next to La Gelateria, a popular upscale cafe and restaurant. Formerly the location was a pleasant Italian restaurant called Luigi's. The large mosque Mohammed V is directly across the street.

It is unfortunate that the designer/architect felt it necessary to partially remove the upper stone exterior since it was part of the apartment building’s original structure and destroys the building architect's design. It should not have been allowed.

That said, this bank is fairly attractive inside, though sparce and very quiet. There is a separate ATM machine outside and another one inside. I had thought about opening an account at the CFG Bank, but after an inquiry I was told by an employee that I must be a resident of Morocco.

I do have an account at a BMCI Bank and residency was not required, only my passport was necessary. CFG Bank is based in Casablanca, and as far as I know, it is the only CFG Bank in Tangier.

text.text:
Société Générale is located on a corner one block from "Iberia" (Place de Koweit).  This bank's outside ATM machine usually, but not always, prints out a paper receipt of your transaction. The ATM machine is occasionally out of service but is repaired by the next day.

For some reason, many banks in Tangier and elsewhere in Morocco do not bother to order and install paper for receipts in their ATM machines, so this particular Société Générale bank at Iberia is good to know about if you really do need a printed receipt from its ATM cash machine.

I noticed that after making a withdrawal on December 7, 2017 using my ATM card from a large international bank, there was now a “Withdrawal Fee” of 16.50 Dirhams on a withdrawal of 1,000 Dirhams, as printed on my paper receipt. By 2022, the ATM withdrawal fee had increased to 35 Dirhams per withdrawal, regardless of the amount, however, the conversion rate is better than other banks and usually you get a printed paper receipt from the ATM machine.

text.text:
Very bad experience with BMCE agencies!

Today at 3 p.m., I tried to withdraw money from the ATM of this BMCE agency, but the machine did not issue any notes, and no error message appeared. I then tried to ask the staff inside for help, but despite their visible presence behind the glass, they simply ignored my request.

When the branch manager finally came out, his attitude was far from professional: he didn't even know how to communicate properly and didn't provide any concrete help.

Thinking that it was an isolated problem, I went to another BMCE agency, the one opposite Maroc Telecom. Result ? The ATM wasn't even operational!

I finally had to make my withdrawal at Wafa Bank. Frankly, such incompetence and poor customer service gives no desire to continue to trust BMCE. Avoid if you want reliable service!

J’ai alors essayé de demander de l’aide au personnel à l’intérieur, mais malgré leur présence visible derrière la vitre, ils ont tout simplement ignoré ma demande.

Lorsque le chef d’agence est finalement sorti, son attitude était loin d’être professionnelle : il ne savait même pas communiquer correctement et n’a apporté aucune aide concrète.

Pensant qu’il s’agissait d’un problème isolé, je me suis rendu à une autre agence BMCE, celle en face de Maroc Telecom. Résultat ? Le GAB n’était même pas opérationnel !

J’ai finalement dû effectuer mon retrait chez Wafa Banque. Franchement, une telle incompétence et un si mauvais service client ne donnent aucune envie de continuer à faire confiance à BMCE. À éviter si vous voulez un service fiable !

There are various examples of Modernist architecture in the avenue Mohammed V in Larache. Old Alliance Israelite Universelle School building is just one example. Build in 1913, and in that year the school had 325 pupils. It has complex and distinctive grilles on the windows along with other interesting elements such as the door handle and door knocker. The decoration on the upper part of the building and the detail on the grilles on the windows are similar to those of the Vienna Secession.

In October 2023 during the All Saints holidays, I took the whole family. Knowing that I have the sum of 130,000 dirhams in my account, I went to withdraw a small amount. I learned that my account has been locked since April 2023, 6 months ago. Without my being informed, my account was hacked, the sum of 120,000 dirhams were drained from it by scammers. Seeing that I was not the originator of his transfers, they blocked the account late. In a single day there were 5 transactions of 20,000 dirhams each.
When I asked the director of the agency for explanations. Aucubrvteponse from him and no advice on how to get my money back. The only thing I could do is file a complaint at the police station and the Berkane court.
When I returned to France, I sent 25 emails without receiving a response from them. I alerted the intermediary agency in Orleans, also sent emails to their colleagues at the Berkane agency and received no response from this director. They advised him to file a complaint against the agency and don director. I conclude that this agency is in on it. Involve the Berkane judicial police, it can only be them who are behind this scam. I'm still waiting for a solution.

I put a star only because I want my message to be published
Being a resident of this city but resident in France, I wanted to withdraw money from this ATM. It is then that the counter confirms the transaction but does not give me any ticket. So I decided to contact the banking staff who were inside.
An embittered, haughty woman who didn't even want to respond to the hello which told me that the bank was closed and that she couldn't do anything for me.
I explain to him that via my banking application the withdrawal was made but that no ticket was given by the counter (the zipper). This woman starts screaming and asks me to leave quickly, a dark-haired woman wearing a pink shirt, she starts screaming while explaining that she doesn't care.
I kept my calm and left wishing this woman all the misfortune in the world.
You are the image of the bank, Crédit du Maroc should be ashamed of employing a woman with a lack of professionalism, she should not be confronted with the public because her behavior and her image are the showcase of this bank.
Many people are looking for work and those with a smile.

text.text:
The Omnia Bank Participation Bank is the first Islamic bank to obtain a license from the Bank of Morocco, as it obtained approval on January 2, 2017. The bank indicated on its website that it is “a comprehensive bank that keeps pace with its clients, whether they are individuals, professionals or companies.”
In Morocco, Islamic banks are called participatory banks, as they are not described, either in laws or in advertising campaigns, as Islamic banks.
The new bank said that it provides "a rich package of daily banking products and services, as well as financing, investment, employment, and savings products."

I’ve read a lot about banks and their employees in Morocco. Today, I opened an account at this bank, and I was pleasantly surprised by the service. I was assisted by a friendly employee named Khadija, who was very helpful and professional.

To open an account, you need a rental agreement for an apartment/house or a property ownership document, and a passport (for foreigners). The account can be opened in both dirhams and euros. I can receive funds from abroad in euros and then convert them to dirhams. While I cannot deposit dirhams in cash into my account, it is possible to receive dirhams via bank transfer from a Moroccan account.

Overall, the experience was very positive, especially due to Khadija’s professionalism. I highly recommend this bank if you are looking for a reliable financial institution in Morocco.

cfg, the place is very nice. BUT the service is poor. Starting with the fact that a Forfait bank account was opened for me (something I didn't know, because our Moroccan banks do not use this form, especially not without mentioning it to the client before signing). So, when I wanted to close my account because their sister bank in Europe canceled a transfer from abroad while taking 90 euros, WOW, I was told that I have a package, and I have to pay the monthly which remain, namely 7 or 8 months, before being able to close.

I was told that the fact that my account is a package is mentioned in the contract, YES a contract that I signed without reading, because CFG sends you a courier (got angry because I was late by 5 minutes after arriving at the operating room) who wants you to sign as quickly as possible to get a new victim signed and so on. I should have simply refused to sign.

Good people, don't go to CFG, they are scam artists, they will lure you with their very easy approach to opening an account, one comes to open an account, but when closing it is very difficult.

I strongly RECOMMEND CFG bank maroc.

P.S. my experience was with this agency CFG Bank - Gab Megamall, but I believe that all agencies are the same, because the origin is the same.

text.text:
So clearly we can't just give 0.
Customer since 2008 in this bank with current account, currency, savings I can give you an idea of ​​the circus that you will encounter there.

Positive point: Some nice agents by their nature and not the agency, unfortunately they end up leaving.

Dark spots:
-Reception, customer relations. Poorly trained agents, borderline unpleasant and condescending, completely unreachable remotely (telephone, whatsapp, text messages, emails... Telepathy!).
Unless you are retired and want to travel every day for any need, avoid this bank, and above all this agency would be a good thing for your mental health. Hanout atmosphere.
-Poorly adapted system: requesting an amortization table took 2 months, because the agency has to send a request to Casablanca and bla bla they go around in circles, so imagine having to respond elsewhere within a certain time frame.
-Bank customer since 2008, I have never received a promised call to respond to a need expressed to the agency, and the agent each time asks for my number which has never changed for 20 years which is on its screen
-No hierarchy: no way to escalate anything to anyone, the online site and the application are useless for reporting a problem because there is no monitoring, you can write as much as you want.... nada .
-No operation will take you less than 20 minutes, so be sure you won't have to do anything afterwards.
-The bank changes its clauses discreetly and illegally: I learn that I cannot take out a loan for no reason (probably because I am black). I contacted the business center then the management who ended up telling me yes you will have it but I asked again I was told "the final agreement is still not out" hhh clowns. Imagine if I had no other alternatives.

Brief
Soon I will close all accounts.

Update: there remains a current account, soon to be closed to put this mishap far behind.

This kind of cashier is unworthy of working in such a well-reputed bank that respects its customers.

text.text: Frankly, very disappointed by my visit to the CIH Old Teima bank last Wednesday. The employees there, zero welcome: not a smile, and their responses exuded arrogance. It seemed like they were doing a service to humanity, not that they were there to help customers. I went to open an account, and guess what? The lady supposed to take care of it was "on break" in the middle of the work day. Result: more than 30 minutes of waiting, and still nothing. So, I went to BMCI, and there, it was day and night: welcomed like a king, with a great atmosphere, smiling and ultra-helpful employees. Honestly, I don't recommend CIH until they understand that they are there to SERVE their customers, not do them a favor.

text.text:
Sir

I am writing to you to express my deep dissatisfaction with the service of your bank branch in Ouled Teima. I have recently tried to contact this branch by phone several times, but have never been able to get through to anyone. The calls I made were all ignored and I received no response to my voicemails.

I am extremely disappointed to see that your bank's customer service is so poor. I expect banks to provide superior services, especially when it comes to answering calls from their customers.

I hope you will take the necessary steps to improve the quality of service at this branch. If this situation persists, I will be forced to look for another bank that offers superior services.

I thank you for your attention to this matter and I await a response from you.

Sincerely,
Rida

text.text:
The only known ATM at the airport that does *not* charge additional withdrawal fees. It's located in the departure hall and because the airport is quite small, it's right next to the departure exit and definitely worth walking here.

So once you get to the departure hall and see the exit out of the airport, go right to the large hall with beautiful arches. The ATM is roughly in the middle of the hall at the far side.

It does have an English option and you can only withdraw a maximum of 2000 MAD at one time - if you need more, you just need to repeat the withdrawal process, which is no problem, because it's free. Best to be used with Revolut, Wise and similar banks.

text.text: Al Barid Bank is a Moroccan subsidiary of the Poste Maroc group, the bank has been operational since June 8, 2010. This subsidiary of Poste Maroc, which specializes in financial services, is expected to start with 4 million customers, reaching some 6 million customers in 2013. According to the former General Manager of Post Morocco, Anass Houir Alami, Al Barid Bank will start its business with 900 agencies among the 1800 Post Morocco network. He also said, in an interview with the Moroccan newspaper L'Économiste [1], that this subsidiary will be - initially - neither a bank of companies, nor a market bank, but only a bank of individuals who collect the deposits and distribute the credits.

text.text:
I am extremely disappointed with my experience with Umnia Bank. Here are the major problems I encountered:

Account opening: Opening my account at the El Jadida agency was slow and poorly managed. Despite a long wait with few customers in front of me, the process took a long time. Additionally, obtaining a copy of the contract proved complicated and unpleasant.

Inactive ecard: My ecard has remained inactive for more than two months despite my four visits to the agency. Repeated excuses such as system issues or staff absences never resolved this issue.

Difficulties with the Uconnect app: I had problems changing my password through the Uconnect app. Having forgotten the answer to the secret question, I contacted the agency to reset my password, but after two days of waiting, I still have no solution.

Due to these numerous malfunctions and the poor quality of service, I decided to close my account with Umnia Bank as quickly as possible. I do not recommend this bank due to its lack of organization and ineffective customer service.

originalText.text:
Je suis extrêmement déçu par mon expérience avec Umnia Bank. Voici les problèmes majeurs que j'ai rencontrés :

Ouverture de compte : L'ouverture de mon compte à l'agence d'El Jadida a été lente et mal gérée. Malgré une attente importante avec peu de clients devant moi, le processus a pris beaucoup de temps. De plus, obtenir une copie du contrat s'est révélé compliqué et désagréable.

Carte ecard inactive : Ma carte ecard reste inactive depuis plus de deux mois malgré mes quatre visites en agence. Les excuses répétées comme des problèmes de système ou des absences du personnel n'ont jamais permis de résoudre ce problème.

Difficultés avec l'application Uconnect : J'ai eu des problèmes pour modifier mon mot de passe via l'application Uconnect. Ayant oublié la réponse à la question secrète, j'ai contacté l'agence pour réinitialiser mon mot de passe, mais après deux jours d'attente, je n'ai toujours pas de solution.

En raison de ces nombreux dysfonctionnements et de la qualité médiocre du service, j'ai décidé de clôturer mon compte avec Umnia Bank le plus rapidement possible. Je ne recommande pas cette banque en raison de son manque d'organisation et de son service client inefficace.

In general: Distributor sometimes dysfunctional, or not sufficiently stocked due to the very high traffic due to its location just opposite door 6 of Soukl7add.

Hello, I wanted to share with you my bad experience with this agency.
So I just created an lbankalik account made up of the SMART offer which is 100% "Free" and without account maintenance fees, but when I went to the agency to collect my bank card, the advisor told me added "Avenir Plus" life insurance for which a monthly contribution of 150 dhs is included as well as Epargne d'Or insurance with a monthly contribution of 300 dhs without any authorization, even though I only requested the pack of the offer SMART.
Fortunately I checked my account via the application, and paid attention to this error and the direct debit under the title "Avenir plus direct debit" applied to my account.
Today, when I requested a cancellation of these which are normally the fault of the agency advisor, as well as the reimbursement of the direct debit applied since it was in no way my fault, he refused to select the reimbursement, even he insisted that I continue to benefit from these insurances.
Ultimately, he canceled the insurances, but no refunds were applied.
First of all, with so many errors and problems, it gives a very bad impression towards the Attijari Wafabank Group and its credibility!

Déjà pour commencer avec autant d'erreurs et problèmes, ça donne une très mauvaise impression envers le Groupe Attijari Wafabank ainsi que sa crédibilité!

I would like to make a complaint regarding the service of your bank because their service leaves something to be desired, I am leaving at 9:45 a.m.
To do an operation and I can't find anyone at the counter!!!! Quite simply because we had to wait for them to finish their breakfast!
Do you find it normal that a customer respects opening hours and travels for a service while employees take lightly the missions imposed on them by their position???
It is still an international bank which represents Morocco in Europe and Africa! It’s shameful to have broken arms among your teams like these employees in this agency!
I remind you that there is no shortage of banks in Morocco and that if you do not take the necessary measures to redeploy your workforce you will not only have complaints due to rain but above all terminations!!! It's up to you!

text.text:
Something is wrong, not just the ATM!

When I entered the bank to report that the ATM had debited my account in the amount of 3,000 Moroccan Dirhams, I was instructed to notify my branch in Mirleft. I insisted that the problem took place at their branch in Tiznit and that they should look into this matter. There were two Moroccan women who had had the same problem. Because they were direct clients of this branch, they received customer service. The initial lack of professional attention from the security guard and the staff members on the ground floor impelled me to report the incident to the local police.

Upon returning to the branch accompanied by two police officers, the treatment I received changed dramatically. I was escorted to see the director of the branch upstairs who then lavished me with utmost professional attention. He contacted my branch in Mirleft to alert them of the incident.

My branch has filed a complaint which will take some twenty days to resolve this matter—not three days as they had stated in Tiznit.

Let’s hope the money finds its way back into my account!

I am an attijari customer.

I came to take out travel insurance.
They did everything they could to not do me any favors.

First, I was told if I wanted to pay in cash or by bank transfer, when I said bank transfer, I was told that it was impossible and that I would have to return to my agency in another city.

When I agreed to pay cash, I was asked for ID, I gave my driver's license. It was refused to me on the pretext that “it did not have an expiration date”. I had my passport which “had an expiry date” on me, it was refused too. It was necessary to have the CIN, I was told. Total absurdity if I have 2 documents provided by the state confirming my identity and both containing my CIN number.

I went to see an insurance agency next door, I had my contract in my pocket 5 minutes later.

I just didn't have time to make a Scandal. But I will not fail to come back to explain myself and provide me with the text of the law or regulation which requires the CIN.

Je suis client attijari.

J'avais mon passeport qui " avait une date de péremption" sur moi, on l'a refusé aussi. C'était nécessaire d'avoir la CIN on m'a dit. J'avais juste pas le temps de faire un Scandale. Mais je ne vais pas manquer de revenir m'expliquer et me fournir le texte de loi ou de règlement qui exige la CIN.

text.text:
This is the first time in my life that I have given an opinion, hoping that it will be as useful as possible to others.
If you have the choice, avoid this agency at all costs without even telling the bank because I think it is a problem with Attijariwafa Bank.
But focusing on this agency at the sports roundabout, it is a shame that this kind of agency with this poor quality of service exists in this area.
The agency is dilapidated and dirty. The withdrawal devices never work. And if you come across a day when it works, then be prepared to stay in front of the device for at least 10 minutes while you get your card back. Finally, if the device gives it back to you.
Indeed, if you have the misfortune that the device swallows your card, you will then find yourself facing the staff of this agency who will not help in any way and will only make your experience more unpleasant.
We won't talk about reception. Quite simply because there isn't one. And when you ask for help you will hardly be answered while giving you the impression of being a big bother.
Little more, avoid at all costs the male person with a mustache and bald in an office behind the beam then I assure you that you will be on the verge of incivility.
I don't know if I had the right to this because I am a foreigner and because I don't speak Arabic but
Conclusion, no welcome, outdated, dirty equipment and agency, unpleasant and unhelpful staff. Agency to avoid.

originalText.text:
C'est la première fois de ma vie que je donnes un avis en souhaitant qu'il soit le plus utile possible aux autres.
Si vous avez le choix éviter à tout prix cette agence sans même dire la banque car je pense c'est un problème de Attijariwafa Bank.
Mais en se concentrons sur cette agence à rond point des sports c'est une honte que ce genre d'agence avec cette qualité médiocre de service existe dans ce quartier.
L'agence est vetuste et sale. Les appareils de retraits ne fonctionnent jamais. Et si vous tomber sur un jour où cela fonctionne, alors tenez vous prêt à rester devant l'appareil au moins 10 min le temps de reprendre votre carte. Enfin si l'appareil vous la rends.
En effet si vous avez le malheur que l'appareil avale votre carte, vous vous retrouverez alors face aux personnel de cet agence qui n'aidera en rien et ne rendra vous expérience que plus désagréable.
L'acceuil n'en parlons pas. Tout simplement parce qu'il n'y en a pas. Et lorsque vous demanderez de l'aide on vous repondra à peine tout en vous donnant l'impression de fortement déranger.
Petit plus, eviter à tout pris la personne du genre masculin à la moustache et chauve dans un bureau derrière la poutre alors là je vous assure que vous serez à la limite de l'incivilité.
Je ne sais pas si j'ai eu le droit à cela car je suis étrangère et parce que je ne parle pas arabe mais
Conclusion, pas d'acceuil, appareil et agence vétuste, sale, personnel désagréable et non serviable. Agence à éviter.

text.text:
Have you ever heard an agent at a bank say “get out of my house”? after refusing to let a newly arrived customer pass through your place? you who waited more than 20 minutes? WELCOME TO THE AGENCY OF THE BANQUE POPULAIRE ROMANDIE DE CASABLANCA. I was told to "see what I can do against her", an attitude devoid of any form of professionalism. What makes this situation even more disturbing is that wearing my veil was inappropriately mentioned during the exchange, suggesting discrimination based on my appearance.

Despite this, no apology was offered to me, and the staff clearly showed a complete lack of empathy and consideration for my experience, as well as defying me that no action could be taken against him and continued what they were doing without any respect.

It is essential that all customers, without distinction, are treated with dignity and respect.

originalText.text:
Avez-vous déjà entendu un agent dans une banque qui vous dit «sors de chez moi»? après avoir refusé de laisser faire passer un client fraîchement arrivé à votre place? vous qui avez attendu plus de 20 minutes? BIENVENUE À L'AGENCE DE LA BANQUE POPULAIRE ROMANDIE DE CASABLANCA . On m'a rétorqué de « voir ce que je peux faire contre elle », une attitude dénuée de toute forme de professionnalisme.Ce qui rend cette situation encore plus troublante, c'est que le port de mon voile a été mentionné de manière déplacée au cours de l'échange, suggérant une discrimination basée sur mon apparence.

Malgré cela, aucune excuse ne m'a été présentée, et le personnel a clairement montré un manque total d'empathie et de considération pour mon expérience, en plus de me défier qu'aucune mesure ne pourra être prise à son égard et continue ce qu' il faisait sans aucun respect.

Il est primordial que tous les clients, sans distinction, soient traités avec dignité et respect.

text.text:
Personally, I think that there are many points to improve, notably awareness of the role of the banker and a sense of service as well as customer relationship management to improve the customer experience. I believe this is the basis in this sector of activity.

Unfortunately, during your visit you will notice that the staff of this agency always seem overwhelmed by back office tasks. So, at a simple different request, he sends you back to come back another day as if it's an unpleasant and additional task for him that he didn't plan to do.

And the worst thing is that if you want to get the information by phone it's impossible. No one answers telephone calls to the agency's landline at any time of the day and to all its numbers.

A back and forth which is unpleasant and which wastes time for everyone but above all the relationship of trust which is supposed to be established with the banker.

To the wise...

I thought it was a modern bank with real added value in the customer journey, particularly thanks to the digital advances of their platform. Unfortunately, from a customer relations point of view we could hardly do worse, especially for customers who do not live in Morocco. When your advisor is on vacation or overwhelmed, he or she refers you to the agency director. This promises to process your requests then blocks your number... Cutting short any hope of communication.
Only small mishaps that say a lot about the level of respect for customers and the values ​​of the bank (of the agency at least). For me, this will be enough to explore the market and change banks.

text.text:
The worst cashier employee ever, His name is Zakaria. I'll describe how he looks and, most importantly, how he acts :)

This is a cashier who is overweight, middle aged bald guy, who acts as if he owns the bank. I was completely caught off guard by his arrogance and unkind behavior! My request was simple: I lost my ID due to theft and brought my passport to deposit my rent bill to the owner.

First, he didn't assist me right away. I didn't expect him to, considering his demeanor. It seemed he might have if I brought him cookies because he behaved childishly. Everyone could hear Zakaria telling me that my passport had expired a year ago. I told him it was just two months, and he responded with "who cares."

I was super polite and nice to him, not because I wanted to be, but because I had just woken up. But I am the type of person who will address such behavior directly. As I was leaving the bank without getting my request done, I went back and asked for his name. Instead of telling me his name, he repeated that my passport had expired. I had to repeat myself and say, "It's okay, just tell me your name." I got his name on the second try.

I'm an Attijari client, and their service is right in front of you guys. Try to learn something from their service and treatment of their clients; we're treated like royalty. I changed my phone number linked to my bank account, deposited my entire month's salary, and deactivated my credit card with the same passport that Zakaria called expired a year ago.

Overall, it was just a horrible experience with this so-called employee who can't even talk nicely. He displayed bad manners, was unkind, unprofessional, overweight, bald, and an overall piece of work.

This complaint will also be sent to the Bank of Africa home office.

Le pire employé de caisse jamais rencontré, nommé Zakaria. Je vais vous décrire son apparence et, surtout, son comportement :)

C'est un caissier qui est en surpoids, chauve et agit comme s'il possédait la banque. J'ai été complètement pris au dépourvu par son arrogance et son comportement méchant ! Ma demande était simple : j'ai perdu ma carte d'identité à cause d'un vol et j'ai apporté mon passeport pour déposer mon loyer au propriétaire.

Tout d'abord, il ne m'a pas assisté immédiatement. Je ne m'y attendais pas, vu son attitude. Il aurait peut-être aidé si je lui avais apporté des biscuits, car il se comportait de manière infantile. Tout le monde pouvait entendre Zakaria me dire que mon passeport avait expiré il y a un an. Je lui ai dit qu'il avait expiré depuis seulement deux mois, et il a répondu "et alors".

J'étais très poli et gentil avec lui, non pas parce que je le voulais, mais parce que je venais de me réveiller. Mais je suis le genre de personne qui règle ce genre de comportement directement. En sortant de la banque sans avoir pu effectuer ma demande, je suis revenu et ai demandé son nom. Au lieu de me donner son nom, il a répété que mon passeport avait expiré. J'ai dû répéter ma demande et dire "Ce n'est pas grave, dites-moi juste votre nom." J'ai fini par obtenir son nom à la deuxième tentative.

Je suis client d'Attijari, et leur service est juste devant vous. Essayez d'apprendre quelque chose de leur service et de leur traitement des clients ; nous sommes traités comme des rois. J'ai changé mon numéro de téléphone lié à mon compte bancaire, déposé l'intégralité de mon salaire mensuel et désactivé ma carte de crédit avec le même passeport que Zakaria avait qualifié de périmé il y a un an.

En résumé, ce fut une expérience horrible avec ce soi-disant employé qui ne sait même pas parler correctement. Il a montré de mauvaises manières, était méchant, impoli, en surpoids, chauve et globalement déplaisant.

Cette plainte sera également envoyée au siège de Bank of Africa.

Every interaction with this agency is a nightmare, and the lack of responsiveness makes things even more complicated for a client abroad. I am extremely disappointed with the management of my account, especially being outside Morocco. It is unacceptable that a simple change of telephone number takes more than two months to be processed. I had to beg to have it corrected in order to receive the codes needed to make transactions and access my money.
Being deprived of your own money is one of the most worrying feelings a customer can have with a bank. In addition, the repeated errors regarding my credit and the lack of professionalism of Sara, the personal account manager, are simply unacceptable. The agency also experiences high staff turnover.
I strongly advise against this agency, especially if you are abroad or if you are looking for a fast and reliable service.

text.text:
Every interaction with this bank is a nightmare, and the lack of responsiveness makes things even more complicated for a customer abroad. I am extremely disappointed with the management of my account, especially being outside Morocco. It is unacceptable that a simple change of telephone number takes more than two months to be processed. I had to beg to have it corrected in order to receive the codes needed to make transactions and access my money.
Being deprived of your own money is one of the most worrying feelings a customer can have with a bank. In addition, the repeated errors concerning my credit and the lack of professionalism of Sara, the private account manager at the BMCI la Gironde agency, are simply unacceptable. The Gironde agency also experiences high staff turnover, often with inexperienced employees.
I strongly advise against this bank, especially if you are abroad or if you are looking for fast and reliable service.

originalText.text:
Chaque interaction avec cette banque est un véritable cauchemar, et le manque de réactivité rend les choses encore plus compliquées pour une cliente à l’étranger. Je suis extrêmement déçue par la gestion de mon compte, surtout en étant hors du Maroc. Il est inadmissible qu’un simple changement de numéro de téléphone prenne plus de deux mois à être traité. J’ai dû supplier pour qu’on le rectifie afin de recevoir les codes nécessaires pour effectuer des transactions et accéder à mon argent.
Être privée de son propre argent est l’un des sentiments les plus inquiétants qu’un client puisse ressentir avec une banque. De plus, les erreurs répétées concernant mon crédit et le manque de professionnalisme de Sara, la chargée de clientèle particulière dans l'agence BMCI la Gironde, sont tout simplement inacceptables. L'agence la Gironde connaît également un fort turnover de personnel, avec souvent des employés inexpérimentés.
Je déconseille fortement cette banque, notamment si vous êtes à l’étranger ou si vous recherchez un service rapide et fiable.

**Subject: Reminder regarding pending payment after submitting all documents related to my deceased mother's insurance**

Madam, Sir,

I would like to contact you because, since the death of my mother in December 2023, I am still waiting for the payment of the insured sum of 10,000 dirhams. As an only child, I have closed his account with you and submitted all necessary documents as per the requirements.

Despite my previous steps and a complaint already sent, I have received no response from you, and the payment remains pending.

Please review the status of my application and advise me of the next steps. If any additional documents or information are required from me, I would be grateful if you would let me know.

While awaiting your response, please accept, Madam, Sir, the expression of my distinguished greetings.

---

Madame, Monsieur,

Despite the bank's imminent closure, you took the time to help me transfer money through the app. Your willingness to provide assistance, even in difficult circumstances, has been remarkable. Your attentive listening and responsiveness greatly facilitated the resolution of my problem.

I would like to thank you from the bottom of my heart for your valuable help. You truly embody the values ​​of empathy and efficiency that make the difference for customers. I hope your brand will recognize and reward your exceptional dedication.

Sincerely,
Elasri issam /khalil Amraoui

I recently had a disappointing experience with the Abdelkader Sahraoui agency in Casablanca. After contacting the agency to confirm the availability of a service (in this case a bank card), I was assured by telephone that everything was ready and that I could come to the agency. However, when I went there, I discovered that this was not the case.

This misunderstanding not only caused a waste of time, but the attitude of the employee I spoke with was unprofessional when he placed the blame on me. As a customer, I expected more consideration and reliable information to avoid this type of incident.

I think the agency would benefit from improving communication with its clients and ensuring that the information shared is accurate before transmitting it. Please take these comments into account to provide better service in the future.

text.text:
The treatment of customers is degrading. They do not have any type of education or training in dealing with clients.
They have the sign hanging next to it saying “Working for customer service is our priority”, but they don't even know how to say good morning. With bitter faces and no desire to work.
Today, Tuesday, November 21, at 10:45, a lady helped me at ticket office 3. To was still talking to tell her what she wanted, and she already called the next number, with arrogance and a lack of education... incredible.

Have someone give them training on basic principles of customer service, and explain to them that that is why this agency exists and that their jobs depend on us, the clients.
If Morocco does not advance it is because of the lack of seriousness in matters like this.
And unfortunately, most people leave with their heads bowed, because they do not know how to file complaints or claims.
And that is the force on which irresponsible workers rely: people's ignorance.
That's why I leave my review, to see if someone among them with a hint of responsibility towards their country reads it, and spreads the word for a change towards a better Morocco.

originalText.text:
El trato a los clientes es denigrante. No tienen ningún tipo de educación ni formación para el trato hacia los clientes.
Tienen el cartel colgado al lado con que “Trabajar para el servicio de los clientes es nuestra prioridad”, pero ni buenos días saben dar. Con unas caras de amargados y sin ganas de trabajar.
Hoy, martes 21 de Noviembre a las 10:45 me ha atendido una señora en la taquilla 3. To todavía estaba hablando para decirle qué quería, y ella ya llamó al siguiente número, con una arrogancia y una falta de educación… increíble.

Que alguien les dé una formación sobre principios básicos de atención al cliente, y les explique que para eso existe esa agencia y que sus puestos de trabajo dependen de nosotros, los clientes.
Si Marruecos no avanza es por culpa de la falta de seriedad en asuntos como este.
Y lamentablemente la mayoría de la gente se va con la cabeza agachada, porque no saben poner quejas ni reclamaciones.
Y esa es la fuerza sobre la que se respaldan los trabajadores irresponsables: la ignorancia de la gente.
Por eso dejo mi reseña, a ver si alguien de entre ellos con pizca de responsabilidad hacia su país la lee, y hace llegar la voz para un cambio hacia un Marruecos mejor.

text.text:
The following behavior is in no way representative of the Societe Generale des Banques Marocaines, but rather an individual case that is expressly attributable to the branch and the responsible person - branch manager!

The extent of impudence, there is no more degrading way to "greet" a customer.

At 9:23 the entrance door was still only half open because the cleaning lady was still cleaning at the entrance.

Out of politeness, I stopped and asked the cashier if it was open yet, to which she replied in the affirmative.

So I was just about to enter when the "security guard" appeared out of nowhere and stood in my way.

He didn't respond to my greeting, which in itself is extremely cheeky, but that's not how we're used to "security" in this country, and he boldly asked what I wanted. "I want to go into the bank." Apparently that wasn't enough for him, because the question was now asked the other way around: "What exactly do you want here...?".

Since banking matters are generally no one's business, especially not some third-class security guard who thinks he's Dirty Harry, I answer again: "I want to go to the bank." Discreet, normal tone. This leaves him unconcerned and he boldly asks for the third time. As a cultured person you give in at some point, and I then told him that I would like to transfer my account from Casablanca here.

That worked, and then got me a seat at the desk of the branch manager of this miserable branch.

As soon as I sat down I was left alone. When the lady came back, I asked her who this person - security guard - was and why I was treated so condescendingly even though there were already people inside. Then the cool comment: "That can't be right, you can't say anything against the good man."

This sat with me!! I stood up and simply said that I had no business here and that I would be better off changing banks.

As already mentioned - it's getting boring - you don't ask for much, but there should be a minimum of respect.

The reincarnation of indignity. Thank you Societe General Settat Vol. Hassan II.

PS: I then went about 500m further to the Agence Societe Generale Lalla Aicha, and I can only be amazed at the difference. Polite, courteous, professional... Just the way it should be!

originalText.text:
Das nachstehende Verhalten ist in keiner Weise representativ der Societe Generale des Banques Marocaines, sondern ein Einzelfall der Ausdreucklich der Filiale und der Verantwortlichen Person -Filial Leiterin- zuzuschreiben ist !

Das Ausmass an Frechheit, ein entwuerdigendere Art einen kunden zu "begruessen" gibt es nicht.

Um 9.23 befand sich die Eingangstuer immer noch nur zur haelfte auf, da die Putzfrau noch am Eingang amputzen war.

Ich blieb aus hoeflichkeit stehen, und fragte zur Kassiererin rueber ob denn schon geoeffnet sei, worauf sie bejahte.

Ich war also gerade im Begriff einzutreten, als der "Wachman" aus dem nichts auftauchteund sich mir in den Weg stellte.

Er reagierte nicht auf meine Begruessung, was an sich schon ein ausmassan frechheit ist,aber ist man ja hierzulande nicht anders von "Security" gewohnt, und fragt ganz dreisst was ich will. "Ich moechte in die Bank rein." Das hat Ihm anscheinend nicht gereicht, denn die Frage wurde nun andersrum gestellt: "Was genau willst du hier ...?".

Da Bankangelegenheiten generell niemanden etwas angehen, schon gar nicht irgendeinen wachmann dritter Klasse, der sich fuer Dirty Harry haelt, anworte ich nochmals: "ich moechte in die Bank". Diskret, normaler Ton. Das laesst ihn unbekuemmert, und fragt dreist zun dritten mal nach. Als kultivirter Mensch gibt man irgedwann nach,und ich sagte Ihm Daraufhin das ich mein Konto aus Casablanca hierher transferieren moechte.

Das hat gesessen, und mir dann einen Platz am Schreibtisch der Filialleiterin dieser armseeligen Filiale beschert.

Kaum Platz genommen wurdeich erstmal alleine gelassen. Als die Dame dann zurueck kam, fragte ich sie wer denn diese Person -Wachmann- sei,und warum ich so herablassend behandelt wurde, obwohl aber sich drinnen bereits leute aufhielten. Daraufhin der kuehle kommentar: "Das kann nicht sein, gegen den guten Mann koennen Sie nix sagen".

Das hat bei mir gesessen !! Bin aufgestanen, und habe nur knapp gesagt das ich ja dann hier nichts mehr verloren habe und ich besser dran taete die Bank zu wechseln.

Wie schon mal erwaehnt -wird langsam langweilig-,man verlangt nicht viel, aber ein minimum an Respekt sollte schon sein.

Die reinkarnation der Entwuerdigung. Vielen Dank Societe General Settat Bd. Hassan II.

PS: bin dann etwa 500m weiter zur Agence Societe Generale Lalla Aicha, und kann mich ueber den Unterschied nur Wundern. Hoeflich, zuvorkommend, professionell ... Einfach so wie es sein sollte !

I went there to exchange USD. The service was very slow to begin with. However, I need my money exchanged so I waited.
I handed over my USD and she did the math in the computer and did not give me a receipt but rather counted my money and handed over to me. The money seemed less than the exchange rate posted so I asked for my receipt. She gave me my receipt after a dirty look plus another 200 dirham. I looked up my total on the receipt and counted my money again and I was still short 80 dirham. I asked her again and this time she got all pissed off. Took the money from me and finally gave me the correct amount. This is my 14th day in morroco and so far this was the only time I was about to get scammed and that with a famous bank.

Avoid if possible please.

text.text:
I am very disappointed in the service of this bank. The staff is incredibly rude and seems too out of their depth to help customers normally. Instead of being helpful and customer friendly, it seems like they are just trying to impress, which is definitely not professional.

I am seriously considering switching banks because I believe customers should be treated respectfully. In Europe, banks are much more customer-oriented and know how important it is to be polite and helpful. There is still a lot to learn here in terms of customer focus and service. The problem is also that the people who work in that bank think that the bank belongs to their father. They don't know that they are only employees of the bank. Selling a show with nothing is very low.

Hopefully the bank will take this feedback to heart, because I cannot recommend this bank to others. I will also change banks because entrusting my money to such people is far too low for me.

Ik overweeg serieus om van bank te veranderen, omdat ik vind dat klanten respectvol behandeld moeten worden. text.text:
Opinion on my recent experience at the Ibn Tofaïl agency

A loyal customer for many years, I went to your agency yesterday to make a simple cash withdrawal. My experience was unfortunately frustrating for several reasons:

Lack of clear signage at the counters:
Three counters were open, but no sign or indication specified the services offered at each. I chose an ATM at random and, after a few minutes of waiting, the teller informed me that it was not the right place for withdrawals. With profits of 3.5 billion DHR in 2023, is it not possible to invest in simple signs to guide customers?

Unreasonable waiting time:
After reaching the right counter, I waited more than 20 minutes even though there were only two customers in front of me. The slowness of the service was mainly due to the unavailability of a manager, essential to validate an operation. This absence paralyzed the process.

Incomprehensible administrative requirements:
Finally arriving at the counter to make my withdrawal, providing my account number and my national card, I was asked... for the passport used when opening the account. This appears to be a “regulatory” requirement. However, this passport has obviously expired (every passport in the world expires after a certain time) for years and is therefore no longer in my possession. Such a request is both illogical and a source of frustration, especially since the ID presented proves my identity indisputably.
Following my objection, the manager told me that my current passport could be suitable. So there’s the pompom! They quote me the regulations (passport used when opening the account) and then, we take the liberty of not respecting them, we accept another passport, but not a national card!!!

These various points reflect a total lack of consideration for customers and a lack of organization. A visit to an agency should be simple, quick and efficient, especially for routine operations such as withdrawals.

A soon to be ex-client of the Banque Populaire

originalText.text:
Avis sur mon expérience récente à l'agence Ibn Tofaïl

Client fidèle depuis de nombreuses années, je me suis rendu hier à votre agence pour effectuer un simple retrait d’espèces. Mon expérience a malheureusement été frustrante pour plusieurs raisons :

Absence de signalétique claire aux guichets :
Trois guichets étaient ouverts, mais aucun panneau ou indication ne précise les services proposés à chacun. J’ai choisi un guichet au hasard et, après quelques minutes d’attente, le guichetier m’a informé que ce n’était pas le bon endroit pour les retraits. Avec des bénéfices de 3,5 milliards de DHR en 2023, n’est-il pas envisageable d’investir dans de simples panneaux pour guider les clients ?

Temps d’attente déraisonnable :
Après avoir rejoint le bon guichet, j’ai attendu plus de 20 minutes alors qu’il n’y avait que deux clients devant moi. La lenteur du service était principalement due à l’indisponibilité d’une responsable, indispensable pour valider une opération. Cette absence a paralysé le processus.

Exigences administratives incompréhensibles :
Arrivé finalement au guichet pour effectuer mon retrait, en fournissant mon numéro de compte et ma carte nationale, on m’a demandé… le passeport utilisé lors de l’ouverture du compte. Il s’agit, paraît-il, d’une exigence "réglementaire". Or, ce passeport  est évidemment périmé (tout passeport dans le monde périme au bout dun certain temps) depuis des années et n'est donc plus en ma possession. Une telle demande est à la fois illogique et source de frustration, d’autant que la pièce d’identité présentée prouve mon identité de manière incontestable.
Suite à mon objection, la responsable m'a précisé que mon passeport actuel pouvait convenir. Alors là, c'est le pompon ! On me cite le règlement (passeport ayant servi lors de l'ouverture du compte) et ensuite, on se permet de ne pas le respecter, on accepte un autre passeport, mais pas un carte nationale !!!

Ces différents points traduisent un manque total de considération pour les clients et un manque d'organisation. Un passage en agence devrait être simple, rapide et efficace, surtout pour des opérations courantes comme un retrait.

Un bientôt ex-client de la Banque Populaire

text.text:
Subject: Complaint following discriminatory treatment at the BMCI Semlalia agency

I am writing to you to express my deep dissatisfaction regarding the discriminatory treatment that my friend suffered from one of the cashiers at your BMCI Semlalia agency on the morning of March 20.

In fact, my friend went to your agency to make a simple payment to an account. However, he was forced to wait more than 20 minutes on site because the cashier refused to process his request without obtaining prior approval, which is unusual for a normal payment transaction.

When I reached my friend and asked the cashier about this situation, I was shocked to learn that she had also mistreated my friend because of his clothing appearance, which she said did not meet the standards expected.

Well, let me tell ya about the worst service you might ever run into. This place takes bad service to a whole new level, and trust me, that’s sayin’ a lot in Morocco. I waited for four whole hours after grabbin’ a ticket, only to watch the number on the wall stay stuck for two hours straight. It felt like the employee was on some kind of secret break while 600 people were just sittin’ around waitin’. Honestly, she should be in jail for wastin’ so much of everyone’s time.

So, after all that waitin’, when I finally got to the counter and showed my national ID on my phone, they told me it wasn’t allowed. Now, I get that it might be different here, but everywhere else in the world seems to accept this. It was beyond frustrating, and I didn’t even get the service I was waitin’ for.

In the end, I wasted an entire day for absolutely nothing. These employees really need to face some consequences for their illegal breaks and terrible attitude toward customers. Feels like a serious case of discrimination, if you ask me.

text.text:
I am extremely disappointed with the service provided by Société Générale during my recent attempt to close my account! As a loyal customer for over 8 years, having invested significantly in this bank, I expected professional quality service, but this was not the case.

When I requested to close my account, the bank administrator informed me that he was unable to do so because the relevant employee was on vacation. This response is unacceptable. I should not be required to wait for the employee to return from vacation so that the bank can process my request. It is their duty to respond quickly to my needs as a customer.

Also, when I request a statement, they ask me (another employee) about the inability to get this statement myself through the app, and get the statement already printed, and then he would sign it to make it official. It’s crazy!!!! how can I get a statement already printed? Am I supposed to go to an internet cafe that can make photocopies and ask them to print my bank statement? Impossible! the statement is highly confidential. Finally he gave me the documents, but I felt uncomfortable in this situation.

In conclusion, I am deeply disappointed with the level of service. I cannot recommend this bank to other people!!!

And I would like to thank Madame Hafsa for the professional service she provided me during this period, Thank you very much Hafsa

originalText.text:
Je suis extrêmement déçu du service fourni par la Société Générale lors de ma récente tentative de fermeture de compte! En tant que client fidèle pendant plus de 8 ans, ayant investi considérablement dans cette banque, je m'attendais à un service de qualité professionnelle, mais cela n'a pas été le cas.

Lorsque j'ai demandé la fermeture de mon compte, l'administrateur de la banque m'a informé qu'il n'était pas en mesure de le faire car l'employé compétent était en vacances. Cette réponse est inacceptable. Il ne devrait pas m'être imposé d'attendre le retour de l'employé de ses vacances afin que la banque puisse traiter ma demande, Il est de leur devoir de répondre rapidement à mes besoins en tant que client.

De plus, lorsque je demande un relevé, ils me questionnent (un autre employé) sur l'impossibilité d'obtenir ce relevé moi-même via l'application, et obtenir le relevé déjà imprimé, puis il le signerait pour le rendre officiel. C'est fou !!!! comment puis-je obtenir un relevé déjà imprimé? Est-ce que je suis censé me rendre dans un cybercafé qui peut faire des photocopies et lui demander d'imprimer mon relevé bancaire? Impossible! le relevé est hautement confidentiel. Finalement, il m'a donné les documents, mais je me suis senti mal à l'aise dans cette situation.

En conclusion, je suis profondément déçu par le niveau de service. Je ne peux pas recommander cette banque à d'autres personnes!!!

Et je tiens à remercier Madame Hafsa pour le service professionnel qu'elle m'a rendu durant cette période, Merci infiniment Hafsa

text.text: I wanted to retrieve money from an ATM inside the bank. The machine stated it's out of order, and a woman behind a counter said it had a problem. Then i used another ATM outside (also labeled with CIH Bank) that ATM debited my card, but it had a mechanical problem and did not open the money slot. Luckily, I have a receipt, on which is printed that the ATM has a problem and the transaction failed. That my card was debited before the ATM successfully finished the transaction, shows some fundamental procedural problems in such a trivial, every-day banking process. The woman at the counter was totally unhelpful when I explained this and said she told me there was a problem, it's my problem, I should raise a complaint with a letter. I told her I used the other ATM outside and why do they not put a sign on it or take it offline when they know it has a problem? She did not care in the least. I will clear the wrongful debiting of my credit card with my bank, but I could do without that kind of hassle on my holidays. This bank is pairing negligence with criminal incompetence and hostility towards ripped off customers. Worst banking experience in decades. Just stay away from this place. You can use the ATM 30meters farther, but that one charges 650 Dirhams for the same transaction, which is double the regular rate in Morocco

ALIF is the best place to shelter you interest for arabic language learning.  We visit ALIF two weeks ago and we were all excited by the courses, the activities organised by the Institute as well as the surrounding place. Talented, experienced and super-friendly professors (Mrs. Khadija and Mr. Taoufic are two of our favourites). Superb cultural activities (cooking and calligraphy classes, watching arabic movies, language exchange lunch, arabic music concerts and much more…).Mrs Naoual cooked with us a delicious meat tajine and tasty traditional Moroccan gh’riba biscuits.
ALIF offers a  big range of courses, according to your needs and desires.
It is just the appropriate place to go if you want to immerse yourself in arabic culture and way of living. One of the biggest advantages is that it provides the students with the chance to stay with Moroccan families - a great experience by itself.

Absolutely recommended!!!

text.text:
The Moroccan Bank for Commerce and Industry (BMCI) is one of the most widely used financial institutions currently in Morocco because of the quality of its services and banking products offered as well as its approach to its customers, whether direct or remotely.

BMCI was actually created in 1943 but in order to have a close financial relationship between France and Morocco, the BNP Paribas Group which is a public limited company had taken it among its subsidiaries in 1964. The network being integrated into the euro zone and which currently covers more than 80 countries internationally. This had obtained through the BNP several partners throughout the world, apart from the BMCE Bank which is already established in Morocco as well as the Attijariwafa bank, the Casablanca Stock Exchange and the Banque Populaire du Maroc, we can cite a few placed in certain regions: in Burkina Faso, in Algeria, in the Comoros, in Benin in Cameroon, in Cape Verde, in China, in Gabon, in the Congo in Madagascar, in Brazil, in Togo, Cambodia, Turkey, Mauritius, Guinea, Sri Lanka, and Haiti…

The important strengths which motivated customers to be interested in opening an account with it are mainly because of its fairly reasonable prices compared to other organizations, opening an account is very easy and almost free of charge; by the diversification of the ranges of credits granted, many people are pushed to integrate into it.

Its speed in transactions is widely recognized; its attractive interest and foreign exchange rates are encouraging. Its collaboration with Western Union and other entities by acting as an intermediary in the money transfer system from inside to outside or vice versa, provides it with many advantages both in its relationships with customers and in its own turnover obtained by the commissions received.

Regarding the financial results, BMCI was able to bring out an increase of 4.5% in products in 2014 compared to those of 2013 despite the drop in the BNP Group's results of 33%. On the other hand, the operating coefficient of the said is 48% which still places it among the best Moroccan banks.

The future outlook for BMCI is flourishing in all discount and credit banking operations.

originalText.text:
La Banque Marocaine pour le Commerce et l’Industrie (BMCI) est l’une des institutions financières la plus employée actuellement au Maroc à cause de la qualité de ses services et ses produits bancaires offerts ainsi que sa façon d’approche envers sa clientèle que se soit directe ou à distance.

La BMCI a été réellement créée en 1943 mais afin d’avoir une étroite relation financière entre la France et le Maroc, Le Groupe BNP Paribas qui est une société anonyme l’avait pris parmi ses filiales en 1964. Le réseau étant intégré dans la zone euro et qui couvrent actuellement au niveau international plus de 80 pays. Celle-ci avait obtenu par le biais de la BNP plusieurs partenaires à travers le monde, à part la BMCE Bank qui est déjà implantée au Maroc ainsi que l’Attijariwafa bank, la Casablanca Stock Exchange et la Banque Populaire du Maroc, on peut citer quelques uns placés dans certaines régions : à Burkina Faso, en Algérie, aux Comores, au Benin au Cameroun, au Cap Vert, en Chine, au Gabon, au Congo à Madagascar, au Brésil, au Togo, au Cambodge, en Turquie, à l’Ile Maurice, au Guinée, au Sri Lanka, et en Haïti …

Les points forts importants qui avaient motivé les clients de s’intéresser à ouvrir un compte auprès de celle-ci sont surtout à cause de ses tarifs assez raisonnables par rapport aux autres organismes, l’ouverture de compte y est très facile et presque sans frais ; par la diversification des gammes de crédits octroyés, bon nombre de gens sont poussés à s’y intégrer.

Sa rapidité dans les transactions est très reconnue ; ses taux intéressants appliqués aux intérêts et aux changes sont encourageants. Sa collaboration avec le Western Union et d’autres entités en jouant l’intermédiaire dans le système de transfert d’argent de l’intérieur vers l’extérieur ou vis versa, lui fournie beaucoup d’avantages tant sur ses relations avec la clientèle qu’à son propre chiffre d’affaires obtenu par les commissions reçues.

En se qui concerne les résultats financiers, la BMCI a pu faire sortir une progression de 4,5 % de produits en 2014 par rapport aux ceux de 2013 malgré la baisse du résultat du Groupe BNP de 33%. D’autre part, le coefficient d’exploitation de la dite est de 48% ce qui la place toujours parmi la meilleure des banques marocaines.

La perspective d’avenir de la BMCI se voit bien florissante sur toutes les opérations bancaires d’escomptes et de crédit.

The bank agency must provide help to its customers, especially old and loyal ones, in such situations, and try to solve their problems and find solutions without letting them down.

text.text:
Disappointing customer experience in this Elwifaq agency in Agadir.
- The waiting list system does not work, which leads to frustration and long waits.

- The file that I had prepared and sent online for the creation of my account never arrived at the agency, thus causing an unnecessary delay and a waste of time for everyone.

- The agency appeared to be facing major IT problems. The printer was not working, preventing necessary documents from being printed, and the remittance system was out of service, making any financial transaction impossible. These technical malfunctions not only prolonged the process but also created an atmosphere of chaos and incompetence.

- Another point to note: the lack of chairs, not only did I have to stand while creating my account, but this was also the case for a large part of the customers present. This made the wait even more painful.

However, I would like to point out that Mrs Bizgarn, the advisor, was really helpful and attentive despite these difficult conditions. She did her best to help.

I hope that this feedback will be taken into account to improve the waiting conditions and services of this agency.

originalText.text:
Expérience client décevante dans cette agence d'Elwifaq à Agadir.
- Le système de liste d'attente ne fonctionne pas, ce qui entraine des frustration et une longue attente.

- Le dossier que j'avais préparé et envoyé en ligne pour la création de mon compte n'est jamais arrivé à l'agence, causant ainsi un retard inutile et une perte de temps pour tout le monde.

- L'agence semblait faire face à des problèmes informatiques majeurs. L'imprimante ne fonctionnait pas, ce qui a empêché l'impression des documents nécessaires, et le système de versement était hors service, rendant impossible toute transaction financière. Ces dysfonctionnements techniques ont non seulement prolongé le processus mais ont aussi créé une atmosphère de chaos et d'incompétence.

- Un autre point à noter : le manque de chaises, non seulement j'ai dû rester debout pendant la création de mon compte, mais c'était aussi le cas pour une grande partie des clients présents. Cela a rendu l'attente encore plus pénible.

Cependant, je tiens à souligner que Madame Bizgarn, la conseillère, était vraiment serviable et à l'écoute malgré ces conditions difficiles. Elle a fait de son mieux pour aider.

J'espère que ces retours seront pris en compte pour améliorer les conditions d'attente et les services ce cette agence.

Well disappointment and frustration this time with the lack of response and assistance I have received from your customer service department or let’s say my « advisor » Karim serghouchni (CIH bank med 5) . Despite numerous attempts to contact your bank through phone calls and emails, I have not received any form of acknowledgment or resolution regarding my concerns.

I have been a loyal customer of CIH Bank for more than 8 years , and I have always appreciated the quality of service provided. However, the recent lack of communication has left me feeling neglected and unsupported. As a customer, I believe it is my right to receive timely and satisfactory assistance when I encounter issues or have inquiries, especially having given the assigned advisor who never responded on working hours and when he does he responded on non working hours and then he complained that he supposed not answer since he’s out of duty, but when he’s on duty he never answer which is confusing.

I have diligently followed the recommended channels to seek help, but my efforts have been met with silence. This experience has caused me significant inconvenience and has left me uncertain about the status of my requests. I trust that this is not the level of service CIH bank  intends to provide to its valued customers.

I kindly request that you investigate the matter promptly and provide me with a comprehensive explanation for the lack of response. Additionally, I seek assurance that necessary steps will be taken to rectify this situation and improve the bank's customer service performance moving forward. Specifically I m speaking about my advisor Karim serghouchni who is working in CIH agadir med 5. He literally lacks the communication skills as he just responded to me in WhatsApp audio saying (ngolik a shrif ) which is not close to be a professional way of speaking to costumers, this pushed me to request to change my branch city.

I would appreciate your prompt attention to this matter. I believe in the importance of open communication and trust that you will take the necessary actions to address my concerns. I hope to receive a satisfactory resolution to restore my confidence in CIH bank  commitment to customer satisfaction.

20.06.2023
