text.text:
I would like to express my great disappointment with the customer service of the Banque du Maroc.
Having tried to change my phone number via the mobile application, my request was refused, forcing me to physically go to an agency. Living abroad, this involves taking a plane ticket, which is totally unacceptable for such a simple procedure.

Additionally, when I asked to speak to a manager to understand the situation, I was hung up on several times, and my attempts to call back went unanswered. This lack of consideration and efficiency is inexcusable and does not reflect the service that a customer has the right to expect.

I strongly advise against this bank, whose staff would rather hang up than resolve a problem. Although the application fee is always collected without fail, it is impossible to get help when you need it. This lack of professionalism is unacceptable.

I am requesting urgent customer service improvement and remote inquiry support for customers residing abroad.

I am a customer over 50 years old of the Banque Populaire d’Oujda. In December 2020 I went to Istanbul for medical treatment, the cash I took to cover medical expenses, I wanted to use my bank card with a tourist amount, all the ATMs refused the transaction.
By calling the head of the Al Wilaya d'Oujda agency (out of more than 40 calls) I was answered twice without any solution...
I sent a complaint to the CEO of the Banque Populaire d'Oujda on 01/06/2021, after 40 days of waiting, I was called to see the director (Ms. Belahcen) at 3:30 p.m. she left me waiting until 4:15 p.m. when I left. I call that negligence towards customers. This kind of behavior neither works in the interests of the bank nor the trust of its customers..
Leaving a customer hanging around in a foreign country with his money who cannot use it puts us in total distrust of this bank..
Conclusion * “master carte Gold” bank card which I consider unreliable,
* poor service from the head of the agency indicated above,
* Negligence of complaints to the CEO of BP Oujda (01/06/2021 and 02/15/2021)

text.text:
When visiting a bank, one expects efficient and courteous service. Unfortunately, not all experiences meet these expectations. Here’s a review reflecting such an experience:

Bank Service Review: A Test of Patience

Upon entering the bank, I was greeted not with a smile, but with a queue that seemed to stretch into eternity. The ticking clock mocked the sluggish pace, as minutes turned into hours. It appeared as though the staff, moving at a glacial pace, were in no hurry to hasten the process.

The atmosphere was thick with impatience as customers shuffled restlessly, exchanging weary glances and sighs of frustration. It seemed as though the staff were deliberately prolonging the wait, perhaps to test the limits of our patience.

In an era where time is precious, such disregard for customer time is unacceptable. A bank should be a bastion of trust and efficiency, yet this experience left much to be desired. The service, or lack thereof, was a stark reminder that not all institutions value their clientele’s time.

In conclusion, this bank’s service was a disappointing ordeal. One can only hope that such feedback prompts a reevaluation of their customer service approach.

Worst service ever !

text.text:
I would like to share my recent experience at this bank branch, which left me rather dissatisfied. Upon my arrival, I witnessed an argument between several customers over who had the right to be served first. The reason for this confusion was the absence of a ticket distribution machine, which could easily have avoided this kind of inconvenience.

I am surprised that such a simple and inexpensive solution has not been implemented to improve the organization and efficiency of customer reception. It's important to create an environment where guests feel respected and cared for from the moment they arrive, and this includes taking simple steps to avoid conflicts and misunderstandings.

In addition, I was disappointed to see that there was no reception area dedicated to professionals. The person in charge of this sector was absent from her office, another person in front of her did not even want to inform me about opening a bank account. Such a situation can be frustrating, especially for new professional customers who are looking for suitable banks.

As a potential client, I expected a more professional level of service and a smoother organization within the agency. I believe it is essential that improvements are made to avoid these issues in the future and to provide a more pleasant experience for all customers, whether personal or business.

I sincerely hope that this opinion will be taken into account to identify the necessary points of improvement. My wish is that this agency can provide quality customer service and a smooth experience in the future.

Tahiyaaati

originalText.text:
Je tiens à partager mon expérience récente à cette agence bancaire, qui m'a laissé plutôt insatisfait. Dès mon arrivée, j'ai été témoin d'une dispute entre plusieurs clients au sujet de qui avait le droit d'être servi en premier. La raison de cette confusion était l'absence d'une machine de distribution de tickets, qui aurait facilement pu éviter ce genre de désagréments.

Je suis surpris qu'une solution aussi simple et peu coûteuse n'ait pas été mise en place pour améliorer l'organisation et l'efficacité de l'accueil des clients. Il est important de créer un environnement où les clients se sentent respectés et pris en charge dès leur arrivée, et cela passe par des mesures simples pour éviter les conflits et les malentendus.

En outre, j'ai été déçu de constater qu'il n'y avait pas d'espace d'accueil dédié aux professionnels. La personne en charge de ce secteur était absente de son bureau, une autre personne en face d’elle ne voulait même pas m’informer sur l’ouverture d’un compte bancaire. Une telle situation peut être frustrante, surtout pour les nouveaux clients professionnels qui cherchent des banques à la hauteur.

En tant que client potentiel , je m'attendais à un niveau de service plus professionnel et à une organisation plus fluide au sein de l'agence. Je pense qu'il est essentiel que des améliorations soient apportées pour éviter ces problèmes à l'avenir et pour offrir une expérience plus agréable à tous les clients, qu'ils soient particuliers ou professionnels.

J'espère sincèrement que cet avis sera pris en compte pour identifier les points d'amélioration nécessaires. Mon souhait est que cette agence puisse fournir un service client de qualité et une expérience sans heurts à l'avenir.

Tahiyaaati

To our surprise, not only was she refused this operation without offering a solution, but she was also treated with a profound lack of respect. The employees had unpleasant words towards him, which is unacceptable.

The following month, she tried to make a transfer for the notary. Once again, she was met with a categorical refusal, without them bothering to listen or verify her request. He was abruptly asked to go to his original agency, located in Khenifra, a 5-hour drive from Kenitra. Worse still, a young employee spoke to her badly, making her even more stressed.

My mother, who suffers from high blood pressure, had to go to another agency located just 100 meters from this one. There, she was greeted with professionalism and was able to make her transfer without any difficulty.

I sincerely wonder: what is the point of opening an agency in the city center, near the notaries, if it is to refuse to help your clients and treat them with such contempt?

This experience was deeply shocking and disappointing for our family. I strongly recommend this agency to anyone who wants to be treated with respect and consideration.

originalText.text:
En août dernier, ma mère, une femme âgée et respectueuse, s’est rendue dans cette agence pour retirer une somme de 800 000 DHS, nécessaire à l’achat d’un appartement. À notre grande surprise, non seulement on lui a refusé cette opération sans proposer de solution, mais elle a également été traitée avec un profond manque de respect. Les employés ont eu des paroles désagréables à son égard, ce qui est inacceptable.

Le mois suivant, elle a tenté d’effectuer un virement pour le notaire. Une fois encore, elle a été confrontée à un refus catégorique, sans qu’ils prennent la peine d’écouter ou de vérifier sa demande. On lui a sèchement demandé de se rendre à son agence d’origine, située à Khenifra, à 5 heures de route de Kénitra. Pire encore, un jeune employé lui a mal parlé, la rendant encore plus stressée.

Ma mère, qui souffre d’hypertension artérielle, a dû se rendre dans une autre agence située à seulement 100 mètres de celle-ci. Là, elle a été accueillie avec professionnalisme et a pu effectuer son virement sans aucune difficulté.

Je me demande sincèrement : à quoi sert d’ouvrir une agence en plein centre-ville, près des notaires, si c’est pour refuser d’aider vos clients et les traiter avec autant de mépris ?

Cette expérience a été profondément choquante et décevante pour notre famille. Je déconseille vivement cette agence à quiconque souhaite être traité avec respect et considération.

I would like to share a particularly disappointing experience that I had on Tuesday October 9, 2024, at 3:43 p.m., at the BMCI agency located at the corner of Avenue Mohamed V and Avenue Hassan II.
I went there to make a check withdrawal, even though I am not a customer of this particular agency. According to the schedules displayed on the BMCI website, the agency closes at 4 p.m., and I was therefore confident of arriving on time.
Unfortunately, the welcome I received from the cashier was unacceptable.
Her attitude was rude, and she communicated with a blatant lack of respect.
I had the impression of being a nuisance and being treated as an intruder, which is unbecoming of a bank with the reputation of BMCI.
This is not the first time that I have noticed a lack of professionalism in this agency, but this time pushed me to leave this review.
I am really disappointed with this type of service, and I think it can seriously damage the image of BMCI.
I sincerely hope that measures will be taken to improve the quality of welcome and service in this agency.

text.text:
Poor Customer Service Experience at CIH Bank - Bouznika

Every time I visit the CIH Bank location in Bouznika, I am consistently disappointed by the poor customer service. This branch, like many others, is cramped and overcrowded, making the experience uncomfortable. The staff, especially the lady responsible for receiving loan files and opening new accounts, is often rude and lacks basic respect for clients.

It’s clear that these banks don't prioritize customer satisfaction, and unfortunately, things never seem to change. The least they could do is hire more staff and expand their locations to improve the experience. But with their focus on profit, I doubt this will happen anytime soon.

It also seems like the employees are overworked and underpaid, which could explain the consistently bad moods and lack of professionalism. They appear to be overwhelmed and don’t provide the level of service that should be expected.

Additionally, I’ve tried reaching out to their online service multiple times, but 90% of the time, the calls are either dropped or unhelpful.

I would not recommend CIH Bank to anyone based on my experiences. It’s unfortunate that the quality of service is so poor across the board, and it’s unlikely to improve unless serious changes are made.
